scripts.migrate: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/migration migrate
scripts.verify:migration: pnpm --filter @funwind/db build && pnpm --filter @funwind/content build && pnpm --filter @funwind/migration verify && pnpm --filter @funwind/web verify:render && pnpm --filter @funwind/web verify:fidelity
scripts.verify:all: pnpm check:secrets && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:duplication && pnpm db:build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
